scope: per-frame detection + position + conservative cross-view association; NO temporal tracking

ultra_panorama_debug.purpose: presentation-only projection of representative detection rays; not used for detection, association, or X/Z estimation

image_rescue_confirmation.method: project deferred rescue X/Z into OWNER virtual camera, crop owner image, rerun RF-DETR, require identity-grade match to RESCUE, reject strict duplicate matches
image_rescue_confirmation.diagnostic_overlay: expected RESCUE marker + per-candidate distance, rescue match, owner flag, and strict conflicts

association_config.identity_rule: exclusive logical owner cells create PRIMARY observations. Overlap observations are RESCUE evidence and cannot create a same-frame person alone. Strong source-pixel matches attach RESCUE to PRIMARY. Corroborated rescue-only groups may be promoted; singleton/ambiguous rescues are deferred for future temporal tracking. X/Z never creates identity by itself.
